Angela

NPC entry · expand source and version boundaries as needed

The chicken seller tied to the coop mission, bird pickup and the correct coop climate equipment.

When to look here: Look for Angela when you are buying the first chicken, trying to bring a purchased bird home or checking which climate equipment belongs in animal housing.
